title: Tim Hortons' parent rolls up its sleeves to fix struggling business
主要内容: Tim Hortons, the Canadian coffee chain, is facing challenges in its home market, with same-store sales declining by 1.2% in Canada. As part of its multiyear turnaround, the company is focusing on improving its food and beverage options, store renovations, and its loyalty program to reinvigorate its business. Restaurant Brands, the parent company of Tim Hortons, reported that Tim Hortons accounted for 60% of its total revenue during the third quarter. Despite this, the chain is still responsible for seven out of every ten cups of coffee sold in Canada. The CEO, Jose Cil, emphasized the importance of the drive-thru in store renovations and plans to introduce new spill-resistant lids for its coffee. Additionally, Tim Hortons is testing new products like Nitro cold brew and iced teas in select locations. The company is also expanding its overseas reach, with plans to open 1,500 locations in China over the next decade.
